projects.name: Disneyland - Yas Island
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Disneyland Abu Dhabi, a groundbreaking theme park and resort that marks Disney’s first foray into the Middle East and its seventh global resort. Situated on Yas Island—a renowned entertainment hub already hosting attractions like Ferrari World, Warner Bros. World, and SeaWorld Abu Dhabi—the new park aims to blend Disney’s iconic storytelling with the rich cultural heritage of the United Arab Emirates.

Disneyland Abu Dhabi is envisioned as the most technologically advanced and interactive park in Disney’s portfolio and its most “tech-forward” park yet. The design will feature innovative attractions, immersive experiences, and a unique central castle inspired by crystal formations, symbolizing a fusion of modern aesthetics with traditional Emirati elements.

The resort will offer a variety of themed attractions, accommodations, dining, and retail experiences that integrate Disney characters and narratives with local cultural motifs. The waterfront location allows for creative incorporation of water-based attractions, enhancing the immersive environment.

Disneyland - Yas Island is a greenfield mega urban development project in Abu Dhabi, valued at USD 10000.0 million, at design. Developed by Miral Developers,Miral Developers,The Walt Disney Company. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Disneyland Theme Park - Yas Island
projects.description: The project involves the construction of a Disney theme park on Yas Island, Abu Dhabi. This will be the first Disney park in the Middle East and the seventh in the world. The theme park is expected to be the most technologically advanced and interactive in Disney’s portfolio. It will feature a central castle inspired by crystal formations and local culture, alongside immersive rides and attractions. The park is part of Disney’s USD 60 billion investment in its parks and experiences segment. Disney is introducing water into the design of its iconic castle for the first time, with Abu Dhabi’s version inspired by the sea, nature, and subtle touches from Moana, Elsa, and Anna. This one-of-a-kind creation, unlike any castle before it, will serve as the park’s signature landmark and distinguish it from Disney’s other global destinations. Disneyland Theme Park - Yas Island is a greenfield theme park & water park project in Abu Dhabi, valued at USD 5000.0 million, at design. Developed by Miral Developers,Miral Developers,The Walt Disney Company. Lead consultant Walt Disney Imagineering,Walt Disney Imagineering. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

The project involves the construction of Nawayef Village, the first premium residential community of luxury townhouse units on Al Hudayriat Island, Abu Dhabi. The community features 378 freehold units, including three- and four-bedroom townhouses and five-bedroom twin villas, designed to meet the needs of modern lifestyles.

Strategically located in the valley between Nawayef West and East Hills, Nawayef Village is a gated, integrated development that combines privacy, luxury, and community living. The architectural design draws inspiration from Tuscany, offering residents an enchanting environment with serene coastal surroundings. The neighborhood is within walking distance of high-end retail outlets, dining destinations, and essential community services.

The development emphasizes wellness and connectivity, featuring extensive green spaces, lush gardens, and a full range of resident-focused amenities. These include a kids’ play area, swimming pool, yoga zone, fitness center, games room, co-working space, parking spaces, and a beach club. In addition, residents will enjoy access to the culturally inspired Nawayef Souq, retail shops, and panoramic views of a verdant park and the surrounding waterfront.

projects.name: Villa del GAVI - Dubai Islands

Each residence is curated with luxury finishes and branded interiors. The architecture is designed to maximize views of the Arabian Gulf, offering floor-to-ceiling windows, open-concept living areas, and private balconies. Amenities include two infinity edge swimming pools, a Technogym fitness center, a private residents’ clubhouse, and a design-forward lobby with pieces from Cassina, Minotti, FLOS, ZONDA, Lalique, and LASVIT. The development offers exclusive access to a Priority Club providing services such as chauffeur-driven Rolls-Royce transport, private Riva boat rides, personal training, in-residence spa treatments, and 24/7 maintenance. Located just 20 minutes from Downtown Dubai and DIFC, the community offers easy access to beaches, championship golf courses, shopping malls, and healthcare facilities. A dedicated service management company will oversee all resident services to ensure a consistently high-quality experience. projects.name: Hewi - Nad Al Sheba 4
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a next-generation community park in Nad Al Sheba 4 as part of the Hewi Dubai initiative, an effort to redefine public spaces in Dubai through community-focused, culturally inspired design. The park is located between a mosque and a residential neighbourhood, chosen specifically for its walkability and strong sense of community.

This modern park draws inspiration from the traditional Emirati fareej and is co-designed with residents to meet the needs and preferences of the surrounding community. Key features include Al Decha, a shaded gathering space near the mosque, offering a calm retreat for elders to connect over Arabic coffee or tea. Al Saaha serves as a flexible indoor-outdoor venue for events, workshops, and celebrations, encouraging residents to take ownership of their shared environment.

The park also includes Al Yalsa, a family-oriented seating area overlooking a children’s play zone, perfect for relaxation and informal gatherings. Additional design elements such as meandering paths and nature-based play areas promote intergenerational interaction, physical activity, and exploration. Together, these features establish a vibrant, inclusive space that celebrates local culture while encouraging healthy, social lifestyles.

projects.name: Expansion of Rochester Institute of Technology - Phase 2 - Dubai Silicon Oasis
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a major expansion of the RIT Dubai campus at Dubai Silicon Oasis. The development spans 85,000 square meters, increasing the campus’s built-up area by 217%, bringing the total area to 124,000 square meters. Upon completion, the campus will be able to accommodate approximately 4,500 students, a 115% increase in capacity. The expansion includes the construction of nine new academic and administrative buildings, offering advanced educational facilities, modern laboratories, research spaces, and an expanded parking structure.

The first phase will focus on two academic buildings for the Departments of Science & Arts and Business Administration, two administrative buildings, a student center, a dining hall, and enhanced parking capacity.

The second phase will feature additional facilities for Mechanical and Industrial Engineering, cutting-edge science labs, innovation centers, sports facilities, and a library. The campus will also introduce five new specialized research centers: the Energy and Sustainability Center, Smart Cities Center, Innovation and Entrepreneurship Center, Modern Manufacturing and Materials Processing Center, and the Center for Empowering People of Determination.

projects.name: Sobha Central
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Sobha Central, a landmark mixed-use development by Sobha Realty located on Sheikh Zayed Road in Dubai. Designed as a “vertical urban sanctuary,” the masterplan includes six premium residential towers connected via an elevated circulation path that links residents to a variety of amenities, including a state-of-the-art gym, theatre, clubhouse, and select lift cores with internal access to a luxury shopping mall, restaurants, supermarkets, and a Grand Hall.

Sobha Central will launch with 1,225 residential units in its first tower—The Horizon—offering a curated mix of one- and two-bedroom apartments targeted at modern homeowners and investors. The towers will feature private themed courtyards nestled within a central green park, offering over 250,000 sq. ft. of open space. Sky-level amenities will include landscaped terraces, infinity pools, wellness lounges, and recreational decks.

The development will also include 160,000 sq. ft. of luxury retail space, a car-free shopping and dining podium, and 175,000 sq. ft. of leasable office space. Eco-conscious features such as energy-efficient HVAC systems, EV charging stations, double-glazed façades, and advanced district cooling systems are integrated into the design to ensure long-term sustainability.

Strategically located for excellent connectivity, Sobha Central offers quick access to key areas like JBR, Dubai Marina, Dubai Internet City, and Media City—making it a highly attractive destination for both residents and investors. 

Sobha Central is a greenfield mega urban development project in Dubai, valued at USD 3600.0 million, at design. Developed by Sobha Realty. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

Designed for sophisticated living, the residences will offer top-tier amenities and five-star hospitality services in line with Waldorf Astoria’s global standards.

Strategically located in the heart of Yas Island, future residents will enjoy direct access to key attractions including Ferrari World, Warner Bros. World Abu Dhabi, SeaWorld Abu Dhabi, Etihad Arena, the scenic Gardenia Bay waterfront promenade, and the mangroves of West Yas. projects.name: The Next Chapter - Jumeirah Golf Estates
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of a large-scale, mixed-use community called The Next Chapter at Jumeirah Golf Estates. The masterplan spans 4.68 million square meters and marks a major expansion of the iconic Jumeirah Golf Estates community. This premium development is set to deliver approximately 12,000 new residential units, including a variety of luxurious housing options such as 62 exclusive hilltop mansions.
The project is divided into several distinct zones, each offering unique features:

  • Central Park District: Approximately 5,088 residential units
  • Equestrian Village: Approximately 512 homes catering to lifestyle and sporting enthusiasts
  • Golf Course North and South: Integrated with a new 18-hole golf course, enhancing the golfing experience and surrounding residential zones
  • Tennis Stadium Complex: Around 816 residential units alongside Dubai’s largest tennis stadium with a 5,000+ spectator capacity
  • Town Centre: Approximately 1,117 residential units serving as a vibrant commercial and social hub
  • Village District: Approximately 2,976 residential units offering family-friendly living spaces


Beyond premium residences, the development prioritizes wellness, leisure, and retail, featuring a vast 1.5 million square meters of green and open space, alongside 48,000 square meters dedicated to retail and food & beverage outlets. The community integrates extensive sports facilities, including multi-purpose complexes, swimming lakes, and fitness centers, all within a carefully landscaped, eco-friendly urban environment.

At the core of the community lies a meticulously designed 18-hole golf course with a clubhouse, driving range, and dedicated golf academy, solidifying Jumeirah Golf Estates’ legacy as a world-class golf destination. Additionally, a state-of-the-art equestrian center specialized in show jumping offers premium stables, training arenas, and competition facilities, fostering a vibrant equestrian community.

Anchored by a sprawling 131,850 square meter Central Park, the community’s infrastructure includes an international academy on a 46,000 square meter plot, nurseries, healthcare facilities, multiple mosques, and civic amenities, ensuring convenience and liveability for residents of all ages.

This visionary development sets a new benchmark for sustainable, luxurious urban living in Dubai, combining world-class amenities, diverse housing options, and seamless integration with nature and sports, creating a legacy community for generations to come.

The Next Chapter - Jumeirah Golf Estates is a greenfield mega urban development project in Dubai, valued at USD 6000.0 million, at concept. projects.name: Ash Mount School - Mudon
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Ash Mount School, a premium International Baccalaureate (IB) continuum educational facility located in the Mudon community of Dubailand, Dubai. Once complete, the purpose-built campus will accommodate up to 2,400 students from Kindergarten through Grade 12. The school is designed to offer all four IB programmes: the Primary Years Programme (PYP), Middle Years Programme (MYP), Diploma Programme (DP), and the Career-related Programme (CP).

The campus will feature advanced educational and recreational facilities, including modern classrooms, science laboratories, drama, art, and music studios, as well as dedicated sports infrastructure such as swimming pools, tennis courts, and multi-purpose sports pitches. The Tranquillity Collection emphasizes privacy and a deep connection to nature while maintaining urban connectivity.

Residents can enjoy a wide range of top-tier amenities, including an exercise gym, swimming pools, a running path, and a dedicated Forest Experience Center. The neighborhood also provides direct access to grocery stores and restaurants, while high-end fixtures and features ensure that luxury living is effortlessly blended with outdoor exploration. A nature-inspired façade distinguishes the development within Dubai, offering cutting-edge architecture and unique features unlike any other.

The project involves the construction of Akala Hotel & Residences, a luxury wellness-focused mixed-use development comprising two 50 floors -220-metre towers located in Za'abeel 2, Bur Dubai. The project is branded as the world’s first 'precision wellness' destination, integrating advanced medical diagnostics, performance therapies, and hospitality under one concept.

The development features 534 branded residential units ranging from one-bedroom apartments to a multi-level penthouse known as The Observatory, with panoramic views of the Burj Khalifa. The two towers—Akala Hotel Tower 1 and Akala Residences Tower 2—share a podium that houses a range of wellness and clinical amenities. These include a high-performance fitness centre, indoor lap pool, group training studios, private training pods, spa suites, and wellness studios for yoga, meditation, and sensory therapies.

A key feature is a full-floor medical wellness clinic operated by Everwell, offering advanced treatments such as stem cell and exosome therapy, PRP, gut biome correction, osteopathy, chiropractic, and more. Residents benefit from personalised wellness services including lifestyle and nutrition programs, vitamin C-infused showers, soundproofed rooms, circadian lighting, air and water purification systems, and smart home integrations.

Amenities include multiple swimming pools, a cinema, yoga areas, spas, saunas, amphitheatre, wellness and lifestyle concierge services, in-home treatments, curated dining based on genetic profiling, and more. Outdoor spaces feature a temperature-controlled L-shaped pool deck, children’s pool, and pool bar with nutrient-rich refreshments. The architectural design incorporates biophilic elements and sustainability innovations, achieving LEED Gold and WELL Silver precertifications.

Aimed at high-net-worth individuals, Akala represents a new model of living where residential comfort, preventative healthcare, and personalised wellness converge. Future expansions of the Akala brand are planned across key global cities in the Middle East, Europe, and Australia.

Gate Eleven comprises a curated selection of elegant one- and two-bedroom apartments. Each unit has been designed to cater to both individuals and families, with spacious layouts, luxurious finishes, and cutting-edge smart home systems that allow residents to control lighting, climate, and security remotely.

Beyond the private units, the project emphasizes community living. It includes a wide range of lifestyle and wellness amenities such as an infinity pool, a fully equipped gym, a sauna, a boxing studio, yoga studio, kids' play area, and a lobby lounge. Additional facilities include a restaurant, wellness centre, pharmacy, market, and table tennis area—enhancing both convenience and quality of life.

Strategically positioned just minutes from Downtown Dubai, The Dubai Mall, and Dubai International Airport, with direct connectivity to Al Ain Road, Gate Eleven provides a tranquil, accessible living experience within one of the most desirable neighborhoods in Dubai.

Aimed at redefining the ultra-luxury living standard, the development integrates timeless design, sustainability, and smart technologies to create a vibrant residential environment that fosters wellness, social connection, and long-term investment value.

projects.name: South Square - Dubai South
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of South Square, a premium residential development, located along Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road near the newly announced terminal of Al Maktoum International Airport. The development comprises four towers—two rising 9 storeys and two rising 16 storeys—offering over 550 residential units in a mix of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments. These residences are designed with modern architecture and a focus on wellness-inspired living.

South Square is a thoughtfully planned community featuring a wide range of lifestyle and wellness amenities, including landscaped outdoor areas, scenic water features, seed farms, yoga decks, walking trails, and multi-age fitness and leisure zones. The development also includes co-working spaces, essential retail and dining outlets, and is positioned to provide residents with day-to-day convenience.

The surrounding area offers a well-developed infrastructure, including a 50,000 square-foot hypermarket, a mosque, sports courts, public parks, a petrol station, and a public bus route connecting to the Expo Metro station. The community is close to the GEMS Founders School and is home to over30,000 residents enjoying a range of gated apartment and townhouse options.

Catering to both individuals and families, the development supports healthy and connected living, with design elements promoting interaction with nature and community life.

projects.name: Downtown Residences - Business Bay
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Downtown Residences (DWTN Residences), a landmark 110-storey-plus residential twin-tower development in Business Bay, Dubai. Rising to a height of 445 metres, it will be the tallest project undertaken by Deyaar to date and one of the tallest residential towers in Dubai.

The development will comprise 522 high-end residential units, offering a range of one- to three-bedroom apartments, duplexes, penthouses, and an exclusive Royal Palace located at the tower’s summit. Residents will enjoy 180-degree panoramic views and access to over 75,000 square feet of world-class amenities.

Key features include:

  • Dynamic Avenue, which hosts playrooms, multi-function lounges, kids' creative spaces, and curated social retreats.

  • Sensory Oasis, located mid-tower, featuring floating gardens, air yoga zones, AI meditation pods, an invisible spa, and fitness areas.

  • Summit Society, situated around the 100th floor, offering fine dining concepts, private lounges, a screening room, and the Legacy Lounge.

  • A Residents Club with AI-powered workspaces, private executive pods, and networking hubs designed to enhance both productivity and community engagement.

projects.name: DO Hotels & Residences - Dubai Islands
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of DO Hotels & Residences – Dubai Islands, a premium mixed-use development that blends hospitality, residential, retail, and entertainment functions within a waterfront setting. The development is designed to deliver a unique lifestyle experience centered around the theme of music, AI-powered personalization, and luxury living.

At its core, the project features an AI-powered, music-themed boutique hotel under the One/AD brand, inspired by Amr Diab’s “Live the Beat” philosophy. It combines immersive soundscapes, bold contemporary design, and advanced technology to offer an unprecedented hospitality concept. The hotel includes fully equipped recording studios and services designed for travelers who seek a soulful, interactive experience.

Complementing the hotel are elegant residential units including spacious apartments and penthouses, each equipped with smart home technology that enables residents to manage lighting, climate, and security from their devices. Designed for those seeking a more permanent lifestyle, the residences offer expansive views of the sea, city, and marina.

The broader development integrates retail and dining outlets, from fine dining restaurants to boutique stores, as well as leisure and wellness facilities, including gyms, swimming pools, and community centers. Open green spaces, landscaped gardens, walking and cycling paths, and a waterfront promenade enhance the urban experience by promoting wellness and social engagement.

projects.name: Seamont Autograph Collection Residences - Shams Al Reem Island
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Seamont Autograph Collection Residences by Marriott, a premium residential complex situated in the coastal Shams district of Al Reem Island, Abu Dhabi. The project consists of two elegant G+22 waterfront towers offering 497 high-end units, including 1- to 3-bedroom apartments, expansive 3- to 4-bedroom townhouses, and duplex penthouses.

Designed to offer a resort-inspired lifestyle, the architecture features soft lines, natural stone finishes, warm wooden textures, and panoramic glazing. Over 80% of the residences provide direct sea views, with seamless access to the promenade from the first floor. Select podium-level residences include private terrace gardens, while units on higher levels offer uninterrupted vistas of the surrounding waterfront.

The residential units range in size from 731 to 6,233 square feet and come partially furnished. Residents benefit from 43,000+ square feet of five-star amenities, including an infinity pool, children’s pool, spa with sauna and steam rooms, yoga and cardio studios, a fully equipped gym, indoor cinema, business lounge, library, BBQ areas, outdoor seating zones, and dedicated children's play areas. All units include hotel-style services provided by Marriott, such as 24-hour concierge and security, valet parking, housekeeping, and access to the Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite program.

Strategically located just minutes from Downtown Reem Island, Maryah Island, and the Saadiyat cultural district, the development ensures easy connectivity and a prestigious address. 

Seamont Autograph Collection Residences - Shams Al Reem Island is a greenfield hotel apartments project in Abu Dhabi, valued at USD 435.0 million, at concept. Developed by Marriott International Inc.,Saas Properties,Royal Development Company. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Hamsa 3 - Al Mamsha

The project involves the construction of Hamsa 3, the final residential phase within the Al Mamsha Raseel master development in Sharjah. Hamsa 3 comprises 131 contemporary apartments, available in one-, two-, and three-bedroom configurations. Each apartment features smart home automation, 3.2-metre-high ceilings, and premium interior finishes. The residences offer access to exclusive swimming pools, gym and landscaped communal areas, delivering a serene yet vibrant living experience.

The development also integrates resident-focused amenities such as covered pedestrian walkways, tranquil water features, state-of-the-art security systems, and energy-efficient lighting. Parking is distributed across two basement levels, providing space for over 2,200 vehicles.

Hamsa 3 is strategically located, just minutes from Sharjah International Airport, University City, Sharjah Schools Complex, and University Hospital Sharjah. It also enjoys proximity to shopping hubs like Zahia City Centre and 06 Mall, and the Sharjah Research, Technology and Innovation Park—offering seamless access to both lifestyle and business districts.

Set on an elevated podium, the project features a modern architectural design with calming water elements and landscaped gardens. A vibrant retail promenade further enriches the resident experience, blending urban convenience with natural serenity.

Hamsa 3 - Al Mamsha is a greenfield mid rise (4 - 14) project in Sharjah, valued at USD 13.1 million, at design. Developed by Alef Group. projects.name: Yas Proton Therapy Centre
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of the UAE’s first dedicated proton therapy centre in Dubai. The Yas Proton Therapy Centre will introduce cutting-edge cancer treatment capabilities to the region through the use of proton therapy, an advanced and highly targeted form of radiation therapy that minimizes damage to surrounding healthy tissues.

This world-class medical facility will cater to both paediatric and complex tumour cases, particularly those located near sensitive organs. Proton therapy is renowned for its precision and reduced side effects compared to conventional radiation therapy, making it especially suitable for younger patients and cancers requiring a high degree of targeting.

The Yas Proton Therapy Centre aligns with national healthcare priorities including the National Strategy for Wellbeing 2031, Dubai Social Agenda 33, and Dubai Economic Agenda D33. It will support the emirate’s ambition to become a top global destination for advanced medical care and innovation, while also contributing to Dubai’s Medical Tourism Vision, which aims to attract over 500,000 international patients annually.

Yas Proton Therapy Centre is a greenfield medical / research center project in Dubai, valued at USD 75.0 million, at design. Developed by Dubai Health Authority (Dha),Yas Healthcare. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

Designed to cater to business travelers, media professionals, and leisure seekers alike, the hotel will feature 370 stylish guestrooms and suites that blend luxury with convenience. Guests will enjoy a host of upscale facilities, including a 24-hour reception, valet parking, high-speed Wi-Fi, and a club lounge.

The hotel also boasts world-class dining options, including two signature restaurants and the popular Risen artisanal café, as well as The Nest Club Lounge for relaxed social gatherings. Wellness and recreation amenities include a state-of-the-art fitness center, two outdoor swimming pools with a sundeck and lounge area, streaming entertainment services, and a luxurious spa. Additionally, guests will benefit from exclusive access to Soluna Beach Club on Palm Jumeirah, offering a seamless mix of city luxury and beachfront leisure.

projects.name: Aspirz Tower - Dubai Sports City

The tower features 2 basement levels, a ground floor, 7 podium floors, and 40 additional floors plus a rooftop, with office units occupying the 2nd to 15th floors and residences from the 17th to 40th floors. The residential section features fully furnished convertible hotel apartments, offering three distinct color palette options and access to 30+ amenities. The development includes indoor and outdoor gyms, multiple sports courts, swimming pools, a business center, a cinema, and a kids’ play area, ensuring a comprehensive lifestyle experience. Amenities on the first floor cater to both office and residential occupants, complementing the hotel-style services, such as bell boy assistance, concierge, 24/7 security, and housekeeping. Additionally, a la carte services—including valet parking, personal training, and dry-cleaning—provide further convenience for residents and professionals alike. The project offers a refined selection of 133 residential units which include studio, 1-, 2-, 3-, and 4-bedroom apartments, each crafted with smart layouts and luxurious finishes.

Residents will enjoy a rich mix of lifestyle amenities, including a 40-metre infinity-edge lap pool, a dedicated children’s pool and splash pad, and the Solera Flame Pavilion — a signature outdoor space equipped with a BBQ kitchen for al fresco gatherings.

The development is further enhanced with a sculptural garden, a telescope corner offering panoramic views, a hammock garden, a skateboard park, and a fully equipped gym. Solera also introduces The NOOK, a dedicated social lounge and co-working space tailored to remote professionals and entrepreneurs, providing an environment to connect, collaborate, and innovate.

projects.name: Weybridge Gardens 5 - Wadi Al Safa 5
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Weybridge Gardens 5, an upscale 18-storey residential tower located in DubaiLand Residence Complex, Wadi Al Safa 5, Dubai. The building comprises 168 residential units ranging from studios to three-bedroom apartments, each thoughtfully designed with private pools and modern interiors. The development features an elevated blend of British-inspired architecture and nature-themed design, evident in its petal-shaped geometric façade, curved balconies, vertical structural elements, and integrated lighting.

Residents will enjoy premium lifestyle amenities including a grand ground-floor lobby, private parking podiums, 24-hour security, concierge services, and co-working spaces tailored for modern living. A key highlight of the development is the rooftop sanctuary named “Rebirth,” which draws inspiration from Tuscany's hot springs. This wellness-focused area includes an infinity sky pool, cascading jacuzzis, a Zen-style yoga deck, Baja shelf with in-water sunbeds, BBQ area, open-air cinema, and a traditional Italian pizzeria.

Additional amenities include the LEOS Boxing Academy and Dance Studio, as well as a fully equipped gym, Jacuzzi, landscaped areas, and lounge spaces that promote community living and social wellness.

Comprising 90 residential units, the development is designed around shared courtyard spaces and a large central park that preserves mature, existing trees on-site.

The project emphasizes organic architecture and the use of clean geometry and natural materials to reflect a modern yet nostalgic atmosphere. It seeks to blend heritage with the present by respecting the historical significance of the site while offering contemporary urban living.

Residents will benefit from a wide range of amenities centered around community courtyards, including a clubhouse, wellness area, children’s play area, family swimming pool, lounge, and gym.

California Residences is designed around the principles of green living and wellness. The development will feature landscaped gardens, green corridors, a central park, walking trails, and multiple communal areas. Residents will have access to a wide range of amenities, including a clubhouse, gym, swimming pools, children’s play areas, basketball and tennis courts, cycling tracks, and dedicated social lounges. The architecture embraces a “Minimalist Luxury” concept with open-plan layouts, premium appliances, built-in wardrobes, and modern wood finishes. 

Strategically situated near Global Village, IMG Worlds of Adventure, and key highways like Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Road, the project offers both urban convenience and a serene living atmosphere.

projects.name: Bvlgari Resort & Mansions - Massnoua Island
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Bvlgari Resort & Mansions located in Massnoua Island, an ultra-luxury hospitality and residential development set on a private, horseshoe-shaped island just off the coast of downtown Abu Dhabi. The project blends Italian elegance with Arabian cultural identity in what is described as Bvlgari’s most ambitious development to date.

The resort component will feature a 90-key hotel comprising 60 guest rooms, including two signature Bvlgari Suites and a Bvlgari Penthouse, as well as 30 beachfront villas. Among these is a five-bedroom, 1,200 square metre Bvlgari Villa featuring a private park, beach, and a 20-metre pool.

The resort will be equipped with a wide range of high-end amenities including a 2,000 sqm Bvlgari Spa with a 25-metre lap pool, a 1,000 sqm fitness centre, and an outdoor deck with sweeping sea views. Additional facilities include fine dining venues such as Il Ristorante – Niko Romito, Hoseki, La Spiaggia, and a Turkish restaurant, along with Bvlgari’s signature Il Caffe, Bvlgari Dolci boutique, and La Galleria concept store. A state-of-the-art Yacht Club will anchor the development, offering a private beach, a 40-berth marina, exclusive membership, and access to extensive marine and water sports activities.

The residential component includes 90 private mansions ranging in size from 1,650 to 2,500 sqm. Eight ultra-luxury estates will feature private beaches, and several mansions will include individual docks capable of accommodating yachts up to 25 metres. All residences are designed to offer unobstructed views of the sea, the city skyline, or the island’s tranquil inner cove, blending international contemporary architecture with local design elements.

The development will be accessible via a purpose-built bridge or by sea, ensuring privacy and seamless connectivity. 

Bvlgari Resort & Mansions - Massnoua Island is a greenfield resort project in Abu Dhabi, valued at USD 500.0 million, at design. The developer is not yet recorded. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

The project involves the construction of Khalid Bin Sultan City, a groundbreaking master-planned, mixed-use development spanning a 1.5-kilometer-long plot in Rodhat Al Sidir, Sharjah. The development will integrate 1,500 freehold residential units, including villas, townhouses, and apartments, designed with a focus on sustainability, comfort, and modern amenities. The city is divided into seven distinct neighborhoods, each centered around a public plaza serving as a social and wellbeing hub.

Khalid Bin Sultan City emphasizes a climate-smart, zero-waste approach, incorporating net-zero ready smart infrastructure, renewable energy systems, recycled water infrastructure, and sustainable mobility solutions. The pedestrian pathways are thoughtfully designed with shading elements such as native trees and colonnades to reduce heat and encourage walkability. The city features a continuous two-kilometer shaded linear oasis with running and cycling tracks, sculpture gardens, wellness areas, and shaded courtyards promoting social interaction and serenity.

In addition to residential offerings, the development will include a design and business district serving as an urban hub for creative economy incubators, cultural venues, retail, and entertainment spaces. The project also integrates cultural elements that celebrate Sharjah’s heritage through public art spaces and architecture reflecting local identity. The development aims to foster a cohesive, people-first community with health-focused amenities, children's hubs, wellness clinics, sports facilities, and outdoor cafés.

The project involves the construction of a mixed-use hospitality and commercial development within the Al Rahayel area of Abu Dhabi, comprising the KEZAD Hotel and an adjoining mall. The development aims to serve the growing business and industrial community in the KEZAD zone by creating a modern, integrated business and leisure destination.

The total plot area spans 38,431 square meters, with a built-up area of 29,200 square meters. The architectural concept features a simple yet iconic form, with an emphasis on circulation, visibility, and natural light. The hotel is designed with luxury serviced apartments, offering privacy while maintaining strategic connectivity to the business and retail components of the project.

A standout design feature is the bridge connection at the first floor, linking the hotel and mall. This allows seamless movement between the commercial center and hospitality areas while ensuring privacy for hotel guests. The roof of the business center is envisioned as a leisure area, providing additional recreational amenities without compromising the exclusivity of the hotel residences.

projects.name: Jacob & Co Residences - Al Marjan Island
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Jacob & Co Residences, an ultra-luxury residential development on Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah. The development marks the UAE debut of Indian real estate developer Mantra Properties and the first Jacob & Co-branded residence on the island.

The residences will reflect a fusion of Jacob & Co’s bold, jewelry-inspired design aesthetic with Mantra’s design-led development philosophy. Residents can expect high-end architectural elements, panoramic views, and premium amenities that define modern luxury. The project is envisioned to deliver a landmark living experience - featuring exquisite detailing, opulent interiors, and craftsmanship that echoes the haute horology and jewelry legacy of Jacob & Co.

The development will offer a wide range of amenities designed to provide a resort-like lifestyle. These include a swimming pool, a fully equipped gym, a spa and sauna, a luxurious lobby lounge, and an exclusive beach club. Families will benefit from dedicated children’s play areas, while all residents can enjoy access to sea-facing views and leisure areas that promote relaxation and recreation by the waterfront.

projects.name: Wadeem - Hudayriyat Island
projects.description:
The project involves the development of Wadeem, a premium residential community by Modon on Hudayriyat Island in Abu Dhabi. As the first residential plots offering on the island, Wadeem provides prospective homeowners the rare opportunity to design and build bespoke villas in one of the emirate’s most sought-after and scenic emerging neighborhoods. Situated directly opposite the prestigious Al Bateen area, this launch marks the first availability of land so close to central Abu Dhabi’s elite zones in over 15 years.

Wadeem comprises more than 1,700 residential plots, each large enough to accommodate four- to six-bedroom villas with private swimming pools and spacious outdoor entertainment areas. Strategically located near the island’s coastline, many plots offer breathtaking views of the Abu Dhabi skyline and seamless access to pristine beaches and the Gulf’s serene waters.

The community is designed with a strong focus on wellness and connectivity, featuring a walkable layout with cycling paths interwoven through lush green landscapes. At the center of Wadeem will be a vibrant community hub, complete with a central park, a mosque, a private school, and various retail outlets. For active lifestyles, the development will include a recreational complex with swimming pools, a jogging track, sports courts, and dedicated areas for yoga and meditation.

Residents of Wadeem will also enjoy proximity to Hudayriyat Island’s world-class leisure, hospitality, and adventure attractions, including Nawayef Park, Surf Abu Dhabi, Velodrome Abu Dhabi, 321 Sports, Circuit X, Trail X, Marsana Beach, Bab Al Nojoum beach resort, and the upcoming largest urban park in the emirate.

Wadeem - Hudayriyat Island is a greenfield mega urban development project in Abu Dhabi, valued at USD 425.0 million, at concept. Developed by Modon Properties. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

The project involves the construction of Al Hamra Greens, a wellness-focused residential development consisting of 2 residential buildings (G+2P+9 floors) located within Al Hamra Village in Ras Al Khaimah. This Scandinavian-inspired community is designed around the philosophy of “Reconnect with Living.” The development features 1,754 apartments ranging from one- to three-bedroom units, each offering private balconies that seamlessly integrate indoor and outdoor living spaces.

Al Hamra Greens is set within a naturally rich environment, surrounded by mountains, ocean views, and wildlife, with direct access to the Al Hamra Championship Golf Course. The project promotes a lifestyle centered on nature, sustainability, and meaningful community connection. It aims to foster personal growth, wellness, and a sense of belonging through thoughtfully designed communal spaces and amenities.

Key features include resort-style swimming pools, community green spaces, a pet-friendly park, a state-of-the-art fitness studio, BBQ terraces, paddle tennis and basketball courts, continuous jogging and cycling loops, and dedicated children’s play areas and gaming arcade. Residents will also enjoy proximity to the beach, Al Hamra Marina & Royal Yacht Club, and Al Hamra Mall.

The project involves the construction of Vida Residences Saadiyat Island, a contemporary residential development situated in the heart of Abu Dhabi’s cultural hub, Saadiyat Island. 

The development comprises 121 fully furnished one-, two-, and three-bedroom residences. Each unit is designed with a focus on modern aesthetics, creative architecture, and seamless sophistication. The project is not merely residential but aims to foster a lifestyle-driven community, blending design, culture, and connectivity.

Positioned near major cultural landmarks such as the Louvre Abu Dhabi, the upcoming Guggenheim, and the Zayed National Museum, Vida Residences Saadiyat Island offers residents an immersive experience that combines beachside tranquillity with rich cultural exposure. The location provides easy access to the city centre while maintaining a serene, resort-style environment.

In addition to residential offerings, the project integrates wellness and lifestyle amenities, aligning with Vida’s signature approach to hospitality and community living. It is designed for individuals seeking a vibrant, culturally enriched lifestyle in one of the UAE’s most iconic neighborhoods.

The project involves the construction of Milan Heights, a high-rise residential district within the Azizi Milan master development, located along Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road in Dubai.   • Azizi Milan Heights Tower A – 43 storeys
  • Azizi Milan Heights Tower B – 43 storeys
  • Azizi Milan Heights Tower C – 47 storeys
  • Azizi Milan Heights Tower D – 47 storeys
  • Azizi Milan Heights Tower E – 43 storeys
  • Azizi Milan Heights Tower F – 43 storeys
  • Azizi Milan Heights Tower G – 47 storeys
  • Azizi Milan Heights Tower H – 47 storeys

Residents will enjoy access to an extensive range of integrated lifestyle amenities, including six infinity swimming pools, a lagoon-style pool, five kids’ pools, rooftop infinity pools, a state-of-the-art cinema, fully equipped fitness centre, jogging and bicycle tracks, saunas, jacuzzis, steam rooms, a multipurpose hall, BBQ areas, children’s play zones, and 24/7 security.

The development also offers over 20,000 square metres of retail space, delivering a vibrant, community-centric experience with everyday conveniences.

Architectural design is inspired by Italian sophistication, featuring bold arches, panoramic elevators, and landscaped rooftop gardens. These buildings provide scenic views of green open spaces, water features, and recreational zones. Milan Heights supports Azizi’s broader goal of creating a sustainable, human-centric, mixed-use community, aligned with the Azizi Milan master plan.

projects.name: The Weave - Jumeirah Village Circle
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of The Weave, a 20-storey residential high-rise tower located in JVC District 11, Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai. The building is distinguished by a unique architectural design inspired by the intricate weaving of palm fronds, reflecting Middle Eastern tradition through modern interpretations. The façade showcases flowing, interwoven balconies that evoke a sense of calm and warmth, drawing on the region’s natural aesthetics.

The residential tower offers a range of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom homes, crafted with neutral tones, subtle metallic accents, and bespoke finishes to create serene and functional living spaces. Each unit is designed with spacious layouts that allow residents to personalize their homes while benefiting from calming interior elements and purposeful material selection. A signature feature of The Weave is its rooftop residents club—an elevated amenity hub that seamlessly integrates wellness, fitness, and social experiences. Residents will have exclusive access to a rooftop pool, jacuzzi, ice bath, sauna, gym and yoga space, cinema, social lounge, and barbecue area, all curated to promote relaxation and community living. The Weave - Jumeirah Village Circle is a greenfield high rise (15+) project in Dubai, valued at USD 45.0 million, at design. Developed by The Weave Real Estate Development,Al Ghurair Investments Llc (Al Ghurair Group). Lead consultant John R Harris & Partners (Aukett Swanke). No contractor appointed. projects.name: Bab Al Qasr Canal View Residence 22
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Bab Al Qasr Canal View Residence 22, a premium hotel-branded residential development located along the canal waterfront in Al Raha Beach, Abu Dhabi. Developed by Burtville Developments, the project features three architecturally distinct residential towers designed to maximize natural light and panoramic views of the canal and sea.

Comprising 242 fully furnished units, the residence includes a mix of simplex apartments, duplexes, and exclusive sky villas. Each home is equipped with high-quality interior finishes such as warm wooden flooring, built-in wardrobes, marble accents, and modern appliances. The development emphasizes comfort and convenience through hotel-style services, including optional housekeeping, valet parking, and in-residence dining.

Residents will have access to a suite of lifestyle amenities such as rooftop infinity pools atop each tower, two additional ground-level pools, landscaped green areas, and six retail outlets on the ground floor offering a supermarket, pharmacy, salons, pastry shop, café, and a casual restaurant.

As part of the Bab Al Qasr hospitality partnership, each unit includes five years of complimentary access to Yas Beach Club for up to six people and similar access to the beach and pool facilities at Bab Al Qasr Hotel in Abu Dhabi. Strategically located near Yas Island, Zayed International Airport, and downtown Abu Dhabi, the development is positioned to attract both residents and investors seeking an upscale, well-connected living experience.

Bab Al Qasr Canal View Residence 22 is a greenfield high rise (15+) project in Abu Dhabi, valued at USD 106.1 million, at under construction (100.0 percent complete). Developed by Burtville Developments. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

projects.name: Four Seasons Private Residences - Saadiyat Beach
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Four Seasons Private Residences Abu Dhabi at Saadiyat Beach, a standalone, ultra-luxury beachfront residential community on Saadiyat Island. Designed as an exclusive and gated community, the development will comprise a total of 116 bespoke residences, including 56 luxury villas—among them limited beachfront mansions—and 60 suites, such as penthouses and royal residences.

Set on one of Abu Dhabi’s most prestigious beachfront locations, the residences will feature architecture and interiors that reflect the surrounding natural beauty and coastal environment. Each home is thoughtfully designed to offer a seamless blend of elegance, privacy, and functionality, suited for individuals seeking curated, high-end living.

Residents will enjoy direct beach access and a suite of private, resort-style amenities such as a resident’s lounge, multiple swimming pools, tennis and padel courts, spa and fitness facilities, yoga and meditation studio, cinema, golf simulator, and dedicated children's play areas. Additionally, the community will be serviced by a dedicated Four Seasons residential team offering concierge, housekeeping, wellness, culinary, and property management services to deliver a signature service-rich lifestyle.

Located just minutes from the cultural heart of the capital, the development also benefits from proximity to major landmarks such as the Saadiyat Beach Golf Course, the Zayed National Museum, Guggenheim and Louvre Abu Dhabi, and international transport hubs.

Four Seasons Private Residences - Saadiyat Beach is a greenfield hotel apartments project in Abu Dhabi, valued at USD 2000.0 million, at design. Developed by Alain,Four Seasons Hotel & Resorts. The project involves the construction of 450 townhomes located northeast of Yas Island in Abu Dhabi. The townhomes, comprising three- and four-bedroom units, are thoughtfully designed to blend contemporary living with traditional Emirati values, featuring majlis spaces, multiple entrances, and energy-efficient layouts. Notably, the development includes 26 live-work homes, a first-of-its-kind concept in the UAE, with commercial space on the ground floor and private residences above, allowing for flexible use such as cafés, studios, or retail outlets.

Set within a pedestrian-friendly environment rich in green spaces, the community offers access to a wide range of amenities including schools, mosques, health centres, retail and F&B outlets, parks, and an eco-loop for walking and jogging. Residents will also enjoy sports facilities, an equestrian centre, and an 8.2 km cycling track. Designed around the philosophy of well-being and longevity, the development integrates architecture, lifestyle, and community to support mindful and holistic living.

At the center of Émerge is the first branded Longevity Clubhouse, which serves as a wellness-focused amenity and lifestyle hub. The clubhouse is designed using natural materials and fluid spatial layouts that reduce stress, enhance light, and encourage effortless movement.

The residences are part of the developer’s exclusive Well-being Collection, featuring advanced wellness facilities such as contrast therapy suites with saunas and cold plunges, red light therapy chambers, cryotherapy chambers, hyperbaric oxygen therapy, and a fully integrated smart gym. Each of the 11 residences in this collection is designed as a private wellness retreat, including outdoor saunas, cold plunges, and private pools, allowing residents to integrate wellness seamlessly into their daily routines.

projects.name: SOL Luxe Tower - Trade Centre First
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of Sol Luxe Tower, a landmark mixed-use development located in Trade Centre First on Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai. Standing 280 metres tall with a configuration of a basement, ground, 59 floors, and a roof, the tower is set to become one of the tallest freehold developments on the boulevard.

The development integrates residential, commercial, and retail spaces in one of the city’s most prestigious corridors. The lower levels will house 66 Grade A office units with 3.7-metre ceiling heights and sweeping views of the Dubai skyline, while the ground floor will feature curated F&B retail outlets with 9-metre-high frontages and direct access to Sheikh Zayed Road. The upper levels are dedicated to 288 premium residences in one-, two-, and three-bedroom configurations with studies, offering uninterrupted views of Burj Khalifa and the sea.

Residents will enjoy a host of luxury amenities such as a swimming pool, kids’ pool, gym, indoor-outdoor fitness areas, kids’ play zones, healthcare facilities, landscaped zones, supermarket, private balconies, and basement parking. Additional wellness and leisure features include a jacuzzi with views of Burj Khalifa and Burj Al Arab, rooftop mini golf, yoga decks, barbecue pavilions, multipurpose halls, terrace lounges, and dedicated spaces for families and children. Commercial tenants will also benefit from dedicated amenities such as private meeting rooms and flexible indoor/outdoor event spaces.

The tower’s bronze-and-glass sculptural façade, with curved glass edges and horizontal bronze bands, reflects Dubai’s modern skyline. Sustainability features include high-performance glazing, solar-control systems, water-saving technologies, and EV-ready infrastructure. AI-powered smart systems will enhance building operations through air-quality optimization, predictive maintenance, and secure visitor management.

 

SOL Luxe Tower - Trade Centre First is a greenfield high rise (15+) project in Dubai, valued at USD 599.0 million, at under construction (100.0 percent complete). Developed by Sol Properties. No consultant recorded. No contractor appointed. Completion date not recorded in the source workbook.

These include modern studios, 1–4 bedroom apartments, and ultra-exclusive duplex villas, each thoughtfully designed to maximize space, functionality, and sweeping views of the Arabian Gulf. Breez offers a lifestyle that redefines waterfront living, integrating resort-style amenities with intelligent residential design. The grand lobby will be anchored by a 1,500 sq. ft. aquarium and a waterfall atrium inspired by the rhythm of the ocean, blending theatrical architectural gestures with everyday practicality. Designed to serve Town Square and surrounding communities, the development will embody the ethos, heritage, and high academic standards of Horizon English School, one of Dubai’s long-standing home-grown British curriculum schools with a 35-year legacy.

projects.name: Mandarin Oriental Jumeirah Golf Estates

The project involves the construction of the Mandarin Oriental Jumeirah Golf Estates, Dubai, marking the brand's first dedicated golf resort with branded residences and its third property in the city. The resort will be situated within the prestigious Jumeirah Golf Estates development in the southwestern part of Dubai, envisioned as an elevated, tranquil escape where space, wellbeing, and nature converge.

The property will comprise 121 spacious, beautifully designed rooms and suites. In addition, there will be 97 branded residences ranging from three- to six-bedroom villas, each with its own amenities and private access to a lounge, meeting space, pool, and fitness areas.

A highlight of the resort will be The Spa at Mandarin Oriental, presenting an extensive range of the Group's signature wellness, beauty, and massage treatments in immersive facilities set amid natural surrounds. Nearly 5,000 square metres of space will be dedicated to holistic wellbeing, featuring male and female-only pools, an outdoor meditation area, a barber and a salon, alongside three additional swimming pools. This will be complemented by a comprehensive programme of wellness-led experiences integrated across the resort.

As part of the wider Jumeirah Golf Estates, the Next Chapter development, guests and residents of Mandarin Oriental Jumeirah Golf Estates will enjoy access to exceptional leisure amenities. These include world-class golf facilities with an 18-hole championship course, driving range, academy, and agronomy programmes, complemented by a Golf Clubhouse with lobby and membership lounges, a pro shop, sports bar, gym, and extensive locker facilities. In addition, a dedicated Equestrian Centre and Clubhouse spanning over 7,000 square metres will offer indoor and outdoor arenas, training facilities, stabling, retail, and scenic riding trails. For younger guests, the resort itself will feature a fully serviced indoor and outdoor Kids' Club and a nursery.

Guests and residents will enjoy a choice of six dining venues, including two restaurants at the Golf Club and a Halfway Hut on the course, in addition to Mandarin Oriental's signature elevated gastronomy concepts. The property will also offer extensive meeting and event spaces, including a large ballroom and two outdoor venues, making it an exceptional destination for gatherings.

Residents enjoy resort-inspired amenities such as landscaped podium gardens and terraces, pools and spa facilities, a waterfront gym club, library spaces, and family areas.

projects.name: Al Jazira Club Stadium – Zayed City
projects.description:
The project involves the construction of the new Al Jazira Club Stadium in Zayed City, Abu Dhabi, as part of a 136-acre integrated sports, leisure, and entertainment destination. The development aligns with the Abu Dhabi Economic Vision 2030, aiming to provide world-class athletic infrastructure and community facilities.


The main stadium will feature an initial seating capacity of 24,000, expandable to 30,000, with fully air-conditioned seating and a retractable pitch that can slide out of the main arena. Designed for versatility, the arena can host between 5,000 and 25,000 spectators and will include an operable roof, allowing it to accommodate diverse events such as football tournaments, concerts, conventions, and rugby matches.


Surrounding the main stadium, the master plan integrates a variety of facilities, including training and instructional centers, a tennis academy, a football school, and a multi-purpose sports and leisure club. The Al Jazira Training Facilities will host two full-sized training fields, 40 player residences, and offices for professional teams, while the Youth Academy will include six full-sized fields and supporting infrastructure.


The Al Jazira Sport & Leisure Club will feature fitness areas, pools, an indoor sports hall, a gravity center, commercial spaces, and a conference hall. The Tennis Academy will comprise 16 world-class courts, eight of which will include spectator seating and shading. The Football School will offer indoor and outdoor fields, a pro shop, and 5-a-side pitches.


Complementing the sports infrastructure is a 15-acre community park with a children’s play area, field hockey pitch, sand volleyball courts, cycling and running tracks, and landscaped open spaces. The project will also include restaurants and lounges that remain accessible outside of event times, enhancing its appeal as a year-round destination for residents and visitors alike.
